enriched.title: Vocabulário de Utensílios Domésticos e Tempos Verbais
enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário relacionado a utensílios domésticos e culinária, além de trabalhar os principais tempos verbais em inglês, como Present Simple, Present Continuous, e outros. A prática também inclui verbos irregulares e exemplos de uso contextual.
mainTopics: Vocabulário de utensílios domésticos e alimentos

vocabulary.definition: An unintended hole, crack, or the process through which liquid or gas escapes.
examples: We need to call a plumber. There's a leak in the kitchen.
The roof leaks when it rains.

vocabulary.definition: To take something apart into smaller pieces.
examples: He disassembled the machine to repair it.
You need to disassemble the table before moving it.

vocabulary.definition: Loose earth or soil; any substance that makes something unclean.
examples: Your shoes are covered in dirt.
The garden is full of dirt and rocks.
The floor is dirty; it needs to be cleaned.
He has dirty hands after working in the garden.

vocabulary.definition: A thick, oily substance often used for cooking or lubrication.
examples: The mechanic used grease for the car engine.
Clean the grease off the stove after cooking.

vocabulary.definition: A mark or discoloration caused by a foreign substance.
examples: The coffee left a stain on the tablecloth.
Use this detergent to remove stains.

vocabulary.definition: To become smaller in size, amount, or value.
examples: My shirt shrank after washing it.
Wool tends to shrink if washed in hot water.

vocabulary.definition: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet.
examples: The coffee was too bitter without sugar.
She ate a bitter lemon.
He is a famous actor.
The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
The weather was horrible yesterday.
He had a horrible experience at the restaurant.

grammar.explanation: Used to express habits, general facts, and repeated actions.
rules: Add 's' or 'es' to the verb for third-person singular.
Use the base form of the verb for other subjects.
examples: Birds have serious problems because of light pollution.
She works every day.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions happening right now or temporary situations.
examples: Birds are having serious problems.
She is studying for her exams.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Birds ______ serious problems because of light pollution.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence is in Present Simple, which uses the base form of the verb for plural subjects like 'birds'.

practiceQuestions.question: Rewrite the sentence in Future with going to: Birds have serious problems because of light pollution.
practiceQuestions.answer: Birds are going to have serious problems because of light pollution.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Future with 'going to' requires 'are going to' followed by the base form of the verb.

culturalNotes: Utensílios domésticos como frigideiras antiaderentes são usados em muitos países, mas sua popularidade varia conforme as tradições culinárias.
O peixe frito é um prato comum em várias culturas, incluindo a brasileira e a britânica.
studyTips: Pratique conjugações de verbos irregulares escrevendo frases no passado, presente e futuro.
Use flashcards para memorizar o vocabulário de utensílios domésticos e alimentos.
originalExamples: Birds have serious problems because of light pollution. (Os pássaros têm sérios problemas por causa da poluição luminosa.)
Birds are having serious problems. (Os pássaros estão tendo sérios problemas.)
Birds had serious problems. (Os pássaros tiveram sérios problemas.)
Birds were having serious problems. (Os pássaros estavam tendo sérios problemas.)
Birds will have serious problems. (Os pássaros terão sérios problemas.)
Birds are going to have serious problems. (Os pássaros vão ter sérios problemas.)
Birds have had serious problems. (Os pássaros têm tido sérios problemas.)
